prose: Spott, a Belgium-based AI recruitment management platform, raised a $21 million Series A led by Balderton Capital, CEO Lander Degreve told Axios Pro exclusively. Base10, YC and Fortino participated, bringing total funding to $24 million.
highlights: Spott raised a $21M Series A led by Balderton.
Base10, YC and Fortino also participated.
Total funding reaches $24M for the Belgian AI recruitment platform.
